label: Brownfield retrofit
definition: Reconciliation of legacy as-built records; structural, power and cooling capacity for added density; integration of liquid cooling into air-cooled facilities.

label: Colocation deployment
definition: Division of responsibility between provider and customer; evidence access to provider systems; customer-installed liquid cooling interfacing with provider FWS.

label: Dual-site capability
definition: True independence of sites (shared carriers, identity, staff, providers); data and checkpoint replication; failover capacity match.

label: Edge inference estate
definition: Many small sites with limited on-site staff; remote management; environmental exposure; aggregate outcome across sites.

label: Hybrid cloud/on-premises
definition: Dependency on cloud control planes, identity and networks; data movement; consistent outcome definitions across environments.

label: Hyperscale campus
definition: Shared campus infrastructure (substation, water, heat rejection) across buildings; scale of control planes; grid interaction of large aggregate load.

label: Liquid-cooled high-density cluster
definition: TCS/FWS continuity, CDU power on UPS, thermal ride-through, leak consequence, residual air heat, fluid quality.

label: Modular facility
definition: Factory-integrated modules with vendor controls; interfaces between modules; transport and installation risks.

label: Recovery-capacity pool
definition: Matching accelerator generation, fabric scale and storage; activation time; contention with other demands on the pool.

label: Shared multi-tenant platform
definition: Tenant isolation in compute, fabric and storage; per-tenant outcomes; shared control plane as common mode.

label: Single-site training facility
definition: Site-level single points of failure; correlated training load on site power; checkpoint copy location relative to the site.

label: Sovereign AI environment
definition: Boundary enforcement for data, operations and support; hidden external dependencies; local continuity if external services are withdrawn.
